$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the deny-all database contract, checked by
scripts/check-database-invariants.mjs. Every entry names a real object and
says why it is safe. Removing this file fails the gate.
The functionPrivileges object is the exact signature/role contract for every
function in the application schemas: entry keys are schema-qualified signatures
with identity arguments, and anon/authenticated state whether each browser role
may execute. A function missing from the manifest, a manifest entry naming a
missing function, any PUBLIC grant, or a privilege drift fails the gate.

policyNotes.realtime.messages.assignment_room_broadc: Realtime is broadcast-only. This policy authorizes the exact stored private topic for an active assignment room without granting snapshot access.
policyNotes.realtime.messages.group_broadcast_authz: Realtime is broadcast-only. This policy authorizes a member to read the private group:<id> and chat:<id> topics; no application table is exposed.
